property_summary: For any contract that claims the first-withdrawal bonus and re-enters at least twice, the reentrancy guard must make the outer getFirstWithdrawalBonus revert; deleting '_locked = true' lets the nested claims succeed and the outer call complete instead.
change_summary: Delete `_locked = true;` so the reentrancy guard no longer blocks reentrant calls, exposing different end-state values.
